lines: Follow this page to get timely alerts on
Master's degree applicants at Imperial College, London
A financial support of £10,000 for a year

Imperial College London - GREAT Scholarship 2023 is an opportunity offered by the Imperial College London in partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign to students enrolled in a one-year postgraduate course in Science, Technology, Engineering, Medicine and Business subjects. The selected candidates will receive financial support of £10,000.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
be a citizen of India, Indonesia, Turkey, Kenya, Malaysia, Egypt, Pakistan, Thailand and Nigeria
have been classified as Overseas for fee status
have applied for a one-year full-time master's course
have received an offer of admission to study for a one-year full-time master's course in Science, Technology, Engineering, Medicine and Business subjects by March 13, 2023
be available to commence academic studies in the UK by the start of the UK academic year in September/October 2023
A total of eight scholars will be selected who will receive £10,000.

The candidates will be selected based on the fulfilment of the eligibility criteria.
There are eight scholarships in total, one for each of the countries mentioned.
Candidates might need to pay an application fee to apply for certain subjects like Science and Business at Imperial College Business School.
MSc applicants need to pay GBP 100 to apply.
MBA applicants need to pay GBP 150 to apply.

Candidates facing financial hardship can apply for an application fee waiver. Upon approval of the application fee waiver request, candidates can submit their applications without paying the application fee.
